Narrative: An employee had been climbing up a temporary ladder. He tripped on something on a low roof and struck his head on a piece of racking equipment installed on the roof. He was then descending a ladder and slipped off the ladder approximately halfway down. The employee sustained a laceration and abrasions to the top and back of his head, as well as brain trauma.
An employee was struck by a wire reel that was being dragged by a pick-up truck, suffering two fractured legs.

On November 4, 2020, at approximately 11:45 AM, two Ranger Construction employees were unloading a skid steer loader from a tandem-axle heavy equipment trailer that was attached to a pickup truck. One employee was driving the loader down the trailer's loading ramp when the latch on the truck receiver was released. The weight of the loader on the back of the trailer caused the ring of the trailer receiver to pop up, contacting the latch and pinching the injured employee's left index finger between the latch and the hitch receiver. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was performing road construction in a closed lane of an overpass. As he was assisting a co-worker in saw-cutting a joint in the overpass, he was struck by an automobile, resulting in a broken right shoulder, right leg, and left middle finger, as well as multiple scrapes and lacerations.

On May 6, 2025, an employee was installing structural steel decking on a roof in approximately 99 F weather when he began experiencing muscle cramps, fatigue, chills, and a headache. The employee was hospitalized with dehydration and a kidney injury.

An employee was trying to flip a metal stair stringer over when it fell onto his hand and crushed his index finger between the stair stringer and the concrete resulting in the amputation of the index fingertip.
An employee was cutting a 6-inch fire hydrant pipe with a handheld circular saw. The saw blade came up and struck the employee in the chin and chest, causing lacerations.

A combine bean head was being hauled through a work zone on a trailer. It struck an employee in the head as he poured concrete, knocking him to the ground. The employee suffered a subdural hematoma and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a powered miter saw to cut down a 10-foot trim piece. The employee's left hand and left index finger came into contact with the saw's rotating blade, which amputated the index fingertip.
An employee was installing recessed lights. A spring struck and punctured his eye.

An employee was attempting to set pressure on a pressure release valve and lost control of the end of a fire hose. The hose struck the left side of his face causing a laceration and a fracture that required surgery.

An employee was replacing an underground drain line with a coworker. The employee was bent over when a light pole that was sitting on the ground with the arm section leaned against the wall fell over and hit the employee on the back, breaking two lower back bones.
While working from a ladder to mark dimensions on a truck, an employee fell from the ladder and injured the right and left wrists and left ankle.

An employee was lowering themselves in the basket hoist to assist with adjusting a shim. The corbel came loose and fell onto the basket hoist catching the employee's left middle finger and amputating it at the first joint.
An employee was using a 9" grinder on a skid when the grinder slipped off the skid and slashed the inside of the employee's left upper leg. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was standing on a concrete wall, stripping concrete forms using a pry bar. The employee fell from the wall to the ground 9 feet below, suffering a fractured back and arm.
An employee was holding a concrete form plate with his hands when he was struck by an impact hammer, amputating his left index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was pulling underground cable. The employee's left little finger was caught between a winch/spool and mule tape, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

On December 7, 2021, an employee was holding a piece of equipment while climbing a permanently mounted ladder on the side of a tower structure at a height of about 30 feet. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground and fractured bones.
An employee was removing a test ball from a manhole. An excavator was lifting the test ball when it struck the employee's head, fracturing vertebrae in his neck.

An employee was working inside a manhole, trying to connect an air gun to the an compressor. Air pressure built up; the air gun popped off and hit him between his elbow and wrist on his left arm. He developed cellulitis and was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to relocate a 10-inch flange by hand. During the relocation, the flange started to roll onto its side and the employee attempted to control the flange catching the employee's right middle finger between the rolling flange and another flange on the pallet resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A Ramco employee was directing a dump truck into position at a worksite when a pickup truck backed over the employee breaking both legs.

An employee was on a row of box culverts clearing some material that was in front of the trench box spreader bars. The employee then crossed over the spreader bars while an excavator was pulling the slack out of the cables attached to each side of the trench box. The cables became taut and pulled the trench box forward, catching the injured employee's left foot between the top of the concrete box and the lower spreader bar. The spreader bar then slid on top of the injured employee's left foot, resulting in a left foot/toe injury that required surgery.
An employee was climbing a scaffold ladder when he slipped and fell to the ground 4 or 5 feet below. He suffered a broken femur.
An employee was about 8 feet up an extension ladder when he fell, striking the handrail and then the landing of a stairwell. He suffered broken ribs on the right side, as well as internal bleeding.

An employee was using a wire wheel on an electric hand grinder to remove dried concrete slurry from a vertical steel column while on a 12-foot step ladder. The employee was reaching around the column and fell to the floor resulting in a right femur fracture.
An employee was preparing a choke sling for piping when the excavator rotated and struck the employee. The employee suffered rib fractures and internal bleeding.

An employee was changing a screw driver drill bit while holding a hammer and small pry bar under one arm. The drill activated and caught the employee's glove and the pry bar resulting in amputation of the right index finger at the third knuckle.
An employee was inspecting a residential roof when he lost balance and fell 12 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a left forearm fracture.
An employee was pouring concrete when concrete entered his boots, causing a chemical burn that became infected.
An employee was getting ready to start the kettle motor on the tar kettle. The pipe was not hooked up yet, causing hot tar to burn his face, neck, and arms.

An employee was on a 10-foot ladder. He was about to climb down when it became unstable; after hanging onto ductwork, he fell and suffered a broken lower left tibia and ankle. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee fell off an extension ladder while cleaning fascia. He fell an unknown height and sustained fractured ribs and lacerations.
On April 12, 2017, an employee was nailing plywood to a truss with a nail gun, when the nail gun double jumped and a nail went through his right foot.
A skid steer struck and broke an employee's right leg while the employee was walking.
An employee fell from a ladder and was hospitalized with a broken arm.
An employee fell three stories (approximately 21 feet) while putting up plywood on the third floor of a multi-family residential building. The employee sustained clavicle and shoulder fractures.

Two employees were switching circuits in a circuit breaker when an arc flash/blast occurred. They were running from the blast when an oil-filled transformer exploded burning the employees. One of the employees was hospitalized due to the burns.
While exiting a roof via an extension ladder, an employee fell off and suffered head trauma.

An employee was flagging drivers in a work zone on a public highway. He was struck by a spray truck that was moving in reverse while applying tar during a tar and chip paving operation. The employee suffered trauma to the left side, broken vertebrae, a punctured lung, and trauma to internal organs.

An employee was putting up steel panels on the roof of a building. The employees was using a standing seam roof anchor and a rope with a rope grab. The standing seam anchor came loose from the metal which allowed the employee to free-fall off the roof. As the employee was sliding down the roof, his feet got caught in the gutter which turned him upside down. He sustained a concussion, a severe laceration to his head, and eight fractured ribs.

An employee was trying to access the roof from a ladder when he fell off and hit the ground, breaking his ankle.  The ladder did not extend 3 feet above the access point and was not tied to any structure at the time.

An employee was found unresponsive near a heat recovery steam generator, on his knees with blood around his nose and a bump on the head. He was hospitalized, having suffered a traumatic brain injury, a subdermal hemorrhage, multiple facial fractures, and lumbar and thoracic fractures.

At approximately 8:10 p.m., on 3/25/15, an employee fell 20 to 30 feet from an articulating boom bucket to the ground. The employee was tightening bolts for mast arms on traffic signal lights when the clip tie-off point broke and the employee fell. The employee sustained cracked lumbar vertebrae and head lacerations.

An employee was completing a pre-trip inspection on a dump truck. The employee's right foot became caught in the foot placement hole on the truck, causing him to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a left hip fracture.

An employee was driving an articulating dump truck on a private haul road. While making a turn, the truck left a portion of the roadway at a rough section, causing the cab to articulate vigorously. The employee sustained fractures to the ribs and left ankle, as well as a right knee injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a ladder and lacerated his left arm above his elbow on an air conditioning duct.

Two employees were driving a UTV to the office trailer when the UTV struck a loading dock guardrail. The injured employee was caught between the UTV and the guard rail, resulting in a right hip fracture.

An employee was attempting to reposition the fork on a telehandler. His right pinky finger was between the fork and the mounting bracket when the fork shifted and swung back, crushing his pinky finger.

A worker fell approximately 9 feet from a scaffold platform to the ground below sustaining a compound fracture to the jaw and a punctured liver. The scaffold plank bridged over the apartment breezeway and was supported by two walls that were approximately 6 feet apart. The platform was used in setting the rafter trusses.
An employee was changing the tracks on a John Deere bobcat. As he turned the wheel, his finger got caught in the wrong place, snipping off the end of the left index finger.

An employee was installing a light box while standing on a 2x6 board over a 15-foot tall opening when the board snapped, causing them to fall to the ground. The employee sustained ligament damage to their ankle.
An employee was working on a piece of directional drilling equipment. Its fan blade lacerated the employee's right thumb, index, and middle fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder against the roof when the ladder slipped, causing him to fall to the ground. He sustained fractured vertebrae in his back and was hospitalized.
Worker fell about 42 inches from a scaffold when a scaffold plank broke.

An employee was gathering paperwork to distribute to different offices. When she got up and walked around her chair, her foot got caught on the base of the chair and she fell. She sustained a left pneumothorax, fractured ribs, a scraped left elbow, and injury to her left hip.

An employee was preparing to paint a tank when she noticed a blind flange in the manway that was positioned partially upright from an entrance. The employee attempted to move the blind flange, causing the 280-pound manway to fall over and land on her left foot. The employee was hospitalized and treated for a hematoma on the top of her left foot.
A soil compacting machine rolled over and an employee was caught between the ground and the roll bar.
An employee was using a hammer when it struck his left index finger.
An employee was setting a 15-ton concrete beam when it fell, striking the employee's right leg. The employee sustained a leg fracture that required surgery.

On June 14, 2016, an employee was felling trees and brush around an overhead power transmission line with a chainsaw. The oak tree being felled slit up the middle and toppled to the ground, striking the employee's shoulder and knocking the employee to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractured collarbones and ribs.
An employee was showing the owner the possible issue with the electrical panel when the panel arced. The employee suffered burns to the left side of the face and neck.
Employees were transporting a 40-foot truss on carts. They were readjusting the truss when it was set down on one employee's left middle finger. The fingertip was amputated from the nail up.

On January 7, 2017, at approximately 2:40 p.m., an employee was attempting to lay out structural steel pieces with the assistance of a forklift truck. A steel truss fell over and struck the employee's legs resulting in fractures and crushing injuries to both lower legs.

An employee placed their tools into the bed of their truck to transport them to a hotel. They took a step backward from the truck when their foot caught on a single 2 x 4 that had been left in the lot area. The employee fell and suffered a broken right leg directly above the ankle that required hospitalization.
An employee was working on a sprinkler pipe while standing on a 6-foot ladder when he fell off the ladder and broke his ankle.
On May 2, 2023, an employee was using a circular saw to cut plywood templates to form concrete. The saw amputated the employee's left index and middle fingers.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder to place a clamp when he fell 8 feet to the ground, bruising his forehead and lacerating his nose, lip, and back.

An employee was reeving the main cable on the drum of a crane. The reeving line began to take the weight of the block and pulled the boom down. The employee was standing on a ladder with a 4"x6" piece of wood to keep the reeving cable from sliding across the boom lacings. When the boom pulled down, the employee's right thumb and index finger were pinched between the block of wood and the top of the a-frame ladder he was standing on. The employee suffered an open wound on the thumb and a fracture to the right index finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exposed to hydraulic fluid while servicing a hydraulic line.

An employee was in a building to perform maintenance work on a boiler, chiller, and HVAC system. Looking for roof access, the employee opened a set of double doors on the third floor that opened outward toward a maintenance shaft/elevator shaft. He then looked for a light switch to turn on and stepped forward through the doors. He fell approximately 15-20 feet down the shaft, landing on his lower back on the  trap door . The employee sustained a laceration to the back of their left leg that required stitches.

An employee was picking up a forklift charger with his left hand and dropped it onto his right hand, pinching his right index finger between the charger and the forklift frame. One quarter inch of the finger was amputated.

On November 29, 2019 at 1:15 p.m., an employee was working in the stairway between the 3rd and 2nd floors to de-gloss a handrail. While he was repositioning himself, he lost his balance and fell down the stairs, suffering a 1-inch laceration to the top of his head.
An employee was walking near staging on top of a roof and fell 14 ft. through a hole between the staging and the ladder. The employee sustained 3 broken ribs and a back injury.

On March 16, 2017, an employee was changing evaporator coils on the roof-mounted cooling unit for the store's walk-in cooler.  The employee was going up an extension ladder to access the roof from the street when the ladder slipped from under him and the employee fell approximately 12 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken right leg above the ankle and a shattered heel bone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting (ripping) metal trim on a table saw when the metal kicked back and struck the employee's hand, lacerating fingers. The ring finger was cut into the bone and required surgery.

An employee was assisting with moving a heat exchanger (1,800 pounds) off a pallet jack when the heat exchanger became unstable and fell onto him. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their pelvis and left forearm, requiring surgery.

On September 16, 2024, an employee was cutting metal tubing with a battery-operated bandsaw. The bandsaw jumped out from the tubing and contacted his left index finger, resulting in a laceration to the tendon.
An employee was cutting a piece of plywood with a power saw. The saw kicked back and lacerated his right leg above the knee, causing an 8-inch-long and 3-inch-deep cut.
An employee fell off a roof to the ground and suffered a back injury.

An employee was installing a wood beam as part of the framing for the garage of a new home construction. He was carrying the beam up an A-frame ladder when he lost his balance and fell. The beam fell on top of him. He sustained an eye injury and head laceration.

On November 13, 2015, at approximately 2:30 PM, an employee was working from an aerial lift and signaling a crane lifting a pipe. The crane was overloaded, tipped, and struck the aerial basket the employee was riding in.  The employee was bounced out of the aerial lift. When the crane sat back down, the employee was bounced back in the aerial lift and back out again. The employee suffered a spinal fracture, broken ribs, and multiple facial fractures, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was folding up a ladder. The ladder caught the employee's right index finger and amputated it.
An employee was working on the roof cutting openings. He fell through one of the openings and sustained a pelvic injury.

An employee was in a bucket replacing an existing electrical pole. The employee became entangled in his lanyard. As he was untangling his lanyard, the bucket shifted. A powerline under tension and pulled around a jib frame, rolled up and off the jib frame as the bucket shifted. The power line acted like a rubber band and struck the employee. The employee was ejected from the bucket and fell about 32 feet to the ground. The employee suffered broken bones in both feet and a broken arm.

Employee was standing on the second floor dismantling a metal mod structure when he fell through the sheet metal and cut his left arm to the bone near his elbow. He was wearing fall protection and did not impact the floor but suffered the cut on the way down.
An employee was flagging traffic for a construction site and was struck from behind by a truck exiting the road. The employee suffered two fractured ribs and two fractured vertebrae.
While working on a roof, an employee fell through foam board insulation to the ground. The employee suffered a back injury and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while installing solar panels on a residential roof and required hospitalization.

An employee was applying coating to a weld at a pipe joint when an adjacent pipe shifted, pinning the employee against a second pipe. The employee sustained fractures to his rib cage and tailbone along with bruising to the right leg.

An employee was walking across lanes on a highway to retrieve traffic control material (construction signs, sign stands, and drum rings) from the shoulder when he was struck by a semi-truck. The employee sustained fractures to their right arm/elbow, fingers, and pelvis. He also sustained an open wound on his side above his right hip.
The employee was stacking pipe when he was struck by a pipe. His ear was amputated resulting in an overnight hospitalization.
An employee was using a power drill when their gloved finger was caught in the drill bit, resulting in a finger tissue avulsion.

An employee was on a baker scaffold, working on an air conditioning duct. The duct broke in half and hit the scaffold, causing the employee to fall to the ground about 5 feet below and suffer a broken left ankle.
While coming down a step ladder, an employee lost her footing on the bottom step and hit a door frame. Due to the impact, she injured the right side of her back.
An employee was operating a drill press when their glove caught in the drill bit, resulting in an injury to their finger.

An employee was directing the use of a tow strap to move a vehicle when the employee's left pinky finger was crushed by a quick coupler that was on a rubber tire loader. The employee's finger was amputated up to the knuckle.

An employee was working on the fourth rung of an 8-foot ladder when one leg of the ladder moved and he reacted to the movement. The ladder fell with the employee, hitting the floor. He suffered a left rib fracture and partially collapsed left lung, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a winch on a barge when the rigging came free and hit the protective cage, breaking the cage loose. The cage hit the employee, lacerating his forehead and causing multiple facial fractures. The was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a 6-foot ladder and suffered a wrist fracture requiring hospitalization.

Four Treco, Inc. employees were cleaning tank bottoms at a facility. During the course of bolting a man way cover onto the tank opening with hand tools, an unknown ignition source caused two of the tanks to ignite. One employee suffered second and third degree burns to his face.

On February 18, 2022, an employee was climbing an 8-foot extension ladder to the roof of a one-story house. His feet got tangled with a lanyard attached to his harness, causing him to fall about 8 feet to the ground. He suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a flat roof installing a sound attenuator in a duct bank. While adjusting the position of the sound attenuator, the employee stepped onto a patch of snow, slipped, and fell. The employee suffered a fracture to the right femoral neck and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a ladder installing fluorescent lights in the ceiling. The employee reached for a junction box on the ceiling and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground, resulting in fractures to both arms.
An employee entered a 5-foot trench to fix a broken water line when the trench wall caved in and trapped the employee from the thigh down.
An employee was insulating ductwork over an air handler when he slipped and fell approximately 6-9 ft. to the ground below. The employee sustained head trauma and fractured facial bones.
An employee was installing laminate on the roof when he stepped into a hole and fell approximately 20 feet. He fractured his left elbow, dislocated his pelvis, and required left arm surgery.

Two employees were cleaning out a road widener. The injured employee  was standing in front of the road widener using a hose to clean out concrete from the equipment. The seat in the cab turned and bumped a lever, causing the road widener to move forward. It knocked the injured employee to the ground and then rolled over him. The employee was hospitalized with a broken ankle.
An employee was shutting off a broom tractor. As he was pulling his hand out of the motor compartment, it contacted the motor fan, which amputated his left ring finger.
An employee tripped in a ditch 4-feet deep by 3-feet wide and banged his face on a rock. He was hospitalized.
An employee was critically injured during an altercation at the construction site on March 8, 2017.

An employee was adjusting the forks on a forklift when his right ring finger was caught between the forks and the mast of the forklift. His right ring finger was severely lacerated, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee stepped on a recently poured concrete form and suffered a fractured right foot.
An employee was closing a gang box door. The door closed on the tip of the employee's right ring finger, amputating the tip (with no bone loss).

An employee was using a forklift to lift a splice box from a pit when the forklift tipped over into the pit. The employee was pinned against the splice box, suffering a fractured left forearm and elbow.

An employee fractured his right femur when a stack of steel roofing sheets slid off of the staging area and struck him on his right thigh. The stack of sheets was hit by a tractor with steel forks, which caused the stack to slide off and strike the employee.
An employee was testing a transformer when an arc flash occurred, burning his arms and hands.

An employee was climbing a 6-foot ladder from a 3-foot crawlspace up into the living room level. The ladder moved as he stepped off, causing him to fall to the floor. The employee suffered a dislocated and torn hip socket.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on railroad switches and a pressure-actuated rail greaser. He was attempting to reinstall the connecting bar for the greaser. When he picked up the bar from the middle joint, the joint straightened and amputated his left middle finger distal tip.

An employee was driving the forklift and encountered a metal post shore in the way. He stopped the forklift, shut it down and attempted to move the post shore. While moving the post shore, his right middle finger was caught within the locking hole causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was taking out a screw from a roof panel when he fell from the roof, breaking his ankle/foot and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was spotting a crate that was being unloaded from a forklift when the crate fell off the forks of the forklift, causing him to fall backward and strike his head on the concrete floor. The employee suffered a head injury.
An employee fell through the roof to the concrete floor, requiring wrist surgery.
An employee was drying in a tile roof when he slipped on paper and fell to the ground, suffering back injuries.
An employee was using a jackhammer to break concrete when they struck an electric line. An arc flash occurred and the employee was burned.
An employee was installing wooden forms on shoring when the brace slipped. His hand was caught between the forms, crushing his left middle finger.

An employee developed cramps in the right calf while cleaning up a job site. His symptoms worsened and he was then hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion, low blood sodium, and heat-related muscular injury.
An employee's left hand was caught between the deck of a trailer and a piece of equipment as the trailer bed was lowering. The little finger was amputated.
An employee was removing a strap from a column that was being adjusted using a forklift. The strap released from the load and struck the employee in the face, causing head trauma.
An employee slipped while providing hand signals for an excavator. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was accessing a pedestrian bridge. While approaching a ladder at the end of the bridge, the employee fell 5-8 feet onto the sloped paving, suffering a broken left ankle.

An employee was installing solar panels on the roof of a new-construction two-story home. The employee slipped and fell approximately 14 feet off the roof to the swimming pool below. The employee struck the edge of the pool and sustained rib contusions that required hospitalization.

An employee was kneeling in a 4-foot deep hole trying to fix a leak in the waterline. The sidewalls were wet and the dirt fell from behind the employee onto his left side and crushed him against the pipe. The employee was hospitalized for an injured liver.
An employee was attaching a base frame and mast section together on a hoist when his right middle fingertip was caught between the base frame and mast section, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was descending a ladder at a single-family home. The employee fell from the fourth rung to the ground, suffering a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee slipped and fell while walking through the bottom of a cyclone (large tube) interior, breaking her ankle.
An employee was in a trench cutting a pipe with a cut-off saw when it kicked back and cut his face.

On 6/5/16, at approximately 12:15 p.m., an employee was climbing onto a mobile scaffold to install drywall mud. The employee was ascending an add-on scaffold ladder designed for safe scaffold access when his foot was caught on the second rung. He then fell less than 4 feet, fracturing three vertebrae in his neck.
An employee was shoveling an excavation wall next to a roller when the roller slid down and pinned his leg, causing injuries.
An employee was lifting a flood gate when it dropped onto his right toes. One of the toes was amputated.
An employee was working on a six-foot ladder fishing line through a wall when he fell to the ground and sustained a concussion, broken ribs, and a collapsed lung.
An employee slipped and fell off the back of a flat bed truck. The employee sustained fractured ribs.
An employee was installing lights in a deli area from an 8-foot ladder when the ladder slipped and he fell to ground, fracturing both ankles.

An employee was helping to move a delivery truck that was stuck in snow. A piece of plywood had been put under the tires for traction. It shot out from under the tires and struck the employee's right shin, breaking the tibia and fibula.

An employee was operating a skid steer. He was loading sand into the large hopper when he brought the bucket down and his foot was pinched between the arms of the crossbar and the frame of the cab. As the arms continued to come down, they pulled his foot and ankle over the edge of the cab, resulting in a broken leg.

A maintenance employee was working alone on May 4, 2019. The employee may have been performing a sanding operation in an office and fallen from a 6-foot step ladder. He was found with head trauma and was hospitalized.

An employee was connecting a temporary 480 Volt AC electrical pigtail cord into an electrical box. This pigtail would supply the plug connection for the 480 Volt AC cord for the floor shot blasting machine.  An arc flash occurred burning the employees hands and requiring hospitalization.

On December 17, 2018,  the injured employee was standing near where two other employees were disassembling the winch line from the easement machine. The winch line was being drawn in and the injured employee noticed that the eyelet at the end of the winch line was about to become stuck in the boom tip. As the injured employee grabbed the eyelet with his left hand and twisted it  to free it, the eyelet was abruptly pulled through the boom tip and his left index finger was amputated below the distal joint.

An employee and truck driver were delivering three concrete box culverts on a flatbed truck. As the employee was performing unstrapping and rigging in preparation for unloading the third culvert, the driver moved the truck and the employee was caught between the culvert and an excavator boom. The employee's whole body was pinched, resulting in broken bones and internal injuries.
An employee slipped and fell 16 feet to the floor below while laying floor decking, suffering a broken wrist that required hospitalization.
An employee was holding a column in place when the eyelet broke, causing the column to shift and strike the employee's back. The employee was hospitalized with a back fracture.

An employee was working with his supervisor to trace overhead cables in an existing cable tray inside a facility. The employee climbed a fixed ladder onto an elevated work platform above a production line. The employee was able to see the existing cable tray that was approximately 42 inches below him. He jumped down onto the lower surface to get a better look at the cable tray when he fell through the surface approximately 11.5 feet, landing on sheet glass glass coming through the production line conveyor. The glass broke. The employee suffered a contusion to upper-left shoulder blade, a puncture wound above his left knee, and a laceration to his right upper arm approximately in the middle of his bicep muscle.

An employee was standing on a baker's scaffold approximately 3 feet above finished floor to install equipment. While taking measurements, the locking pins came out on one end of the scaffold, causing the scaffold to collapse. The employee fell 3 feet and sustained a left ankle injury.

An employee was operating a digger derrick with an auger and bucket attachment as old power poles were being removed. Bolts on the machine's boom broke off, causing it to tip over. The employee struck the ground and suffered a broken femur.

On August 18, 2024, at 7:30 PM, an employee loaded a milling machine onto a lowboy trailer. While raising the lowboy deck, the welds broke on the trailer and the trailer dropped to the ground, landing on the employee's right foot. The employee's foot was crushed and multiple bones were broken.

On 04/30/2021 at 12:20 a.m., an employee was assisting two co-workers in retrieving a piece of expanded metal located behind a stack of sheet metal. The stack of sheet metal contained 25 to 30 sheets of 4-foot by 10-foot sheet metal that weighed approximately 50 pounds each, or 1,250 to 1,500 pounds total. While the employee and a co-worker were manually holding the stack of sheet metal, they lost control of the stack and attempted to move clear of the falling metal. The employee's right foot was pinned beneath the stack as it fell, resulting in a foot fracture.
An employee was laying metal decking and fell approximately 15 feet. The employee suffered a fractured left hip and fractures to both arms, the jaw and cheekbones.
An employee was checking the consistency of the mortar in a concrete mixer when the rotating mixer blades amputated their right little finger.
An employee received arc flash burns on the right arm and hand while working in an existing electrical substation.

Employees were installing wood roof trusses, setting them on concrete masonry unit walls that were capped with new double 2-by-6 top plate. The trusses collapsed in a chain reaction, causing three employees to fall to the slab below. One of them, who had fallen about 20 feet to the concrete, suffered two collapsed lungs, several broken ribs, and a broken pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fractured their ankle while positioning items for road construction.

An employee was in a bucket truck attempting to lift a light pole using a rope and a winch. The rope broke causing the employee to fall from the bucket onto the truck. The employee sustained a fractured C-5 vertebra and a fractured shoulder blade.

An employee was forming a footing for a water treatment plant. He was working inside a 4-feet-tall trench form and fell while crossing back over to the outside of the trench, breaking his right tibia and fibula.
While installing utility meters, an employee contacted overhead power lines and sustained burns to their hand and face.
An employee was working from a scissor lift while removing a section of form work from the ceiling. Meanwhile, another section of form work came down and fractured his left leg.

Two employees were attempting to dislodge two steel carts that had become entangled when a cart shifted on its base, coming into contact with the injured employee's right pinky finger. As a result, the employee's right pinky fingertip was amputated.
After he had changed a block and adjusted the wire rope in the sheave, an employee's right hand was pulled between the wire rope and the block. His hand was amputated and required hospitalization.

An employee was using a chain hoist to position a pipe to be welded when the chain caught a valve on the existing pipe and opened the valve, releasing hot water on the employee. He suffered burns to the right arm (from his forearm to his bicep) and right torso (from the ribs to the stomach).
An employee was unclogging a pressure washer when their left hand was struck by the high-pressure water. The employee sustained lacerations and required surgery.

An employee was loading a 4-inch wooden door into a pickup truck when he felt a pop in his right side behind his shoulder blade. He was hospitalized later that day and underwent surgery, having suffered a collapsed right lung.
A telehandler was being operated when it moved to the side and struck a rigger. The rigger sustained a broken right foot and leg.
On June 16, 2023, an employee had been working on an electrical pole. After work, the employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was removing insulation from the sheetrock ceiling of a roof when he stepped on the sheetrock ceiling and fell 20 feet to the floor below. He suffered a fractured skull, broken ribs, lacerated spleen, broken left wrist, and bruised kidney.

An employee was working from a scissor lift during demolition of an internal wall on the second floor. He removed part of the drywall and intended to pull out a metal stud. A metallic electric conduit ran vertically in proximity of the stud. The conduit was not continuous, and a conduit section in the top part had been removed. A live unprotected cable lost insulation from contact with the stud, causing an electric discharge. The employee was electrocuted and hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning out mud from a gas-powered masonry mixer. Once the mud was dislodged, the mixer's paddles began to move and caught his right arm. He suffered an injury to the forearm.

An employee was moving a pressure washer from one section of scaffolding to another section when the weight of the pressure washer on the end of the scaffold caused it to tip over. The employee fell to the ground and fractured his vertebrae.
An employee was working from a stepladder when it broke. In falling, he grabbed the steel rail of a garage door and his right hand was lacerated.

An employee was walking while inspecting recently casted concrete segments when they came into contact with abrasive water during a high-pressure washing operation, resulting in lacerations on their right palm.

On November 10, 2021, an employee was approaching a ladder to climb down from a two-story roof. The employee fell from the roof to the ground, suffering a broken femur and cheekbone. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were hanging an elevator shaft while standing on plywood boards. One board shifted, causing the two employees to fall 31 feet from the third floor to the ground floor. One employee was hospitalized for a lower back fracture and the second employee was hospitalized for a brain bleed.
An employee's finger was lacerated while they were cutting metal roofing with a saw.
An employee was climbing up a scaffold when the scaffold fell over. The employee sustained a broken leg.
An employee was chipping concrete with a rivet buster when an object struck his eye, tearing his cornea. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
On March 12, 2020, an employee was driving a pickup truck along a closed highway lane. The truck hit the side of a skid steer's track, and the employee suffered neck whiplash. He was hospitalized.
On June 29, 2021, an employee passed out on the job site where heat and humidity was a factor. He was hospitalized for a heart attack.

An employee was working to remove an obstruction and free a winch cable that was caught. The cable was still under the load of the probe casing. As the employee pulled the cable free, the weight of the casing caused the winch line spool to tighten around their hand. Their index and little fingers were caught and cut by the cable including tendon damage. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was directing traffic and performing clean-up activities at a site they were preparing for asphalt pavement. The employee was struck by a skid loader that was traveling in reverse, resulting in fractures to the left leg and hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working with a torch 15 feet above the slab in high heat conditions. The employee collapsed and suffered heat exhaustion.
An employee was climbing a ladder when the ladder broke and folded up. The employee fell and sustained fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood and lacerated their left thigh.
An employee was climbing onto a flatbed truck to retrieve materials when he hit and lacerated his head on a steel member of the parking garage, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a 12-foot step ladder when he contacted an electrical conduit that was energized due to a short circuit. The employee was shocked and fell approximately 10 feet to the floor below, resulting in a back injury and rib fractures.

On April 2, 2019, an employee was holding onto a hoist chain with one hand and placed the other hand above the hoist block. As the employee pushed the load away from the handrail, the employee's glove pulled the employee's right hand into the hoist block, pinching the fifth digit between the chain guide and hoist chain. As a result, the employee suffered a right pinky finger distal phalanx fracture and soft tissue avulsion, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was coming down a ladder when he slipped and fell approximately 9 ft. injuring his left leg and arm and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was breaking down a tower crane and removing the boom. His right hand was crushed between the boom as it was being lowered and the crane's turntable. The employee sustained a crushing injury to their hand and the amputation of the index finger.
An employee was loading insulation into a blow machine when he tripped. As he tried to catch himself, his left thumb tip hit a gear and was amputated.
An employee fell while building a scaffold, striking his head.

An employee was working in an attic installing tubing. When the employee finished and was heading back to the stairwell, he stepped on an old access hole and fell through to the concrete below. He suffered heel and vertebrae fractures.

An employee was installing corrugated metal roofing on a boathouse. He stepped onto a piece of corrugated metal and both the metal and the employee fell from the roof. The employee landed on the corrugated piece, lacerating his head and wrists. He was hospitalized for surgery.
